records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Just checking in a few days after you signed up -- how's it going so far? Happy to jump on and help with anything that's unclear.

records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Dara,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Timber Analytics
records.body:
Hi Dara,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to three touches (email:b6dc06b6, email:ec51d414, email:dcbb2298), a no-show kickoff (calendar:a4d65e83), no tickets, and no project, invite, or milestone. No signal of self-driven activity, so unaided activation in 8 days is unlikely though not impossible on a Team plan.

draft.subject: Getting Timber Analytics started in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Dara,

I know a launch week can get busy — sorry we missed each other at the kickoff on the 9th. No pressure to reschedule that full session.

If it's useful, I can walk you through creating your first project in Wrenfield on a 15-minute call this week; projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Just reply with a time that suits and I'll work around your calendar.

If you'd rather sort it yourself, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Chidi
